annotations.text:
Headers are no longer just type. Each one carries an instrument that belongs to its section:

• Your Leagues sits on a green shelf that continues out of the topbar, with your club crests stacked beside it, status pills underneath, and the league cards rising out of its bottom edge.
• Top Rated carries a Matchweek / Season switch, so the header does real work.
• The fixtures head is a scoreboard: an MW tile, the date range, and a ten-segment strip showing finished, live and to come at a glance.
• How Gaffa Works wears the baseline rule as its mark: a track, an ink bar and the median tick.

Two deliberate departures to confirm:

1. No 2px ink rule under section titles. DECISIONS 2026-09-04 still says that is the section pattern, and League Home uses it.
2. League cards and the doors use a soft shadow instead of a border, because they overlap the green shelf and a hairline disappears against it. UI_RULES 6 says bounded objects get a border.
Fixed on this pass after rendering it: ratings now sit in a dark chip so they stop colliding with shirt sponsors, and the market icon (which read as a bin) is now swap arrows.
